description: This is a test file for a FastAPI backend, containing unit tests for project-related endpoints such as project creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion, including authentication and authorization checks.

methods.name: _create_project(client: TestClient, token: str, payload: dict)
methods.description: Helper function to send a POST request to create a project with specified payload and token.

methods.name: test_projects_list_unauthenticated_only_published(client: TestClient, user_credentials)
methods.description: Test that verifies only published projects are visible to unauthenticated users, including project creation and listing.

methods.name: test_projects_create_requires_auth(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that creation of projects requires authentication, expecting a 401 status otherwise.

methods.name: test_projects_get_nonexistent_404(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that requesting a non-existent project returns a 404 status code.

methods.name: test_projects_owner_can_update_and_delete(client: TestClient, user_credentials)
methods.description: Test that the owner of a project can update and delete it successfully.

methods.name: test_projects_other_user_cannot_update_or_delete(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that a user cannot update or delete a project created by another user, expecting a 403 Forbidden.

methods.name: test_projects_create_invalid_skill_ids_returns_400(client: TestClient, user_credentials)
methods.description: Test that attempting to create a project with invalid skill IDs returns a 400 Bad Request.
